newsitem.headline: TABLE - Furniture Brands Int'l Q2 earnings.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Each period included charges for depreciation and amortization resulting from an asset revaluation that occurred when the company emerged from Chapter 11 reorganization in 1992. The non-cash charges, which are ongoing, reduced fully diluted net earnings per common share in the second quarter by $0.05 and $0.10 in the first six months and, in 1996, by $0.05 in the second quarter and $0.11 in the first six months.

Excluding depreciation and amortization resulting from the 1992 asset revaluation, fully diluted net earnings per common share would have been $0.31 for the second quarter of 1997 compared to $0.23 in the same period a year earlier.
Company's full name is Furniture Brands International Inc.
